notes.title: Bug fix - May 25 - No more freezes
notes.content:
[h1]We grabbed the bug and fixed it - fight the leftovers in the updated version![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174148/e0dd913c7733ee4ba47067bdcd2efaa36ee7158a.gif[/img]

[h3]Thanks to your feedback, we were able to navigate and choke the bug causing the softlocks and mid-game freezes. [/h3]

Now, with the problem fixed, you can enjoy Leftovers KO! and train your reflexes to get through all the tasty bosses.

[b]Thank you for reporting[/b] the problem [b]and playing the game[/b] - we hope that your appetite for boxing the stale enemies is evergrowing. 

And remember to leave a review to let us know what you think about Leftovers KO! 🍕

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169060/Leftovers_KO/

notes.title: Hungry? PLAY LEFTOVERS KO! NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GnUDzhbO2Eg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]It's time for lunch... Or rather - a launch?[/h1]

[h2][b][u]Leftovers KO! is officially out![/u][/b] 

Pick up your boxing gloves and show the food scraps who's the boss.[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169060/Leftovers_KO/
[u][b]FIGHT THE LEFTOVERS[/b][/u]
Every leftover has a distinct fighting style, moveset, strengths, and weaknesses. Adapt, be quick, and turn them back into a pile of ingredients.

[u][b]LEARN NEW MOVES[/b][/u]
Learn new moves, practice them in the training room, and use them in real battle to savor the victory.

[u][b]UNCOVER THE MYSTERY[/b][/u]
Why are leftovers all of the sudden fighting back? How is that even possible? Only one way to find out - beat' em up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174148/e989bccd5e407d14732727457b15794637bedf24.gif[/img]

Thank you for all the support throughout this tasty journey - [u][b]we hope that you will enjoy playing Leftovers KO! and are looking forward to your feedback[/b][/u].

And even though the PC version is the first course, it definitely won't be the last - make sure to follow us on social media for more updates!

[b]Enjoy your meal![/b]

notes.title: Demo - Minor bug fix
notes.content:
When the user answers the phone after the second knock down, the Burger seems to not pause and continues to clobber you to death. 

This bug has been fixed and is in the most recent build. 

However, there is one minor bug that will be addressed soon: if you answer the phone and the Burger is paused at the moment of impact when receiving a punch, this will trigger a continuous damage until you die. 

I will make an update when this is resolved.
